title: Technical Writer
description: Professional technical communication: plain language, Diátaxis framework, docs-as-code, OpenAPI specs, SDK guides, style guides, automated linting, and content strategy.

phases.title: Writing & Docs-as-Code Foundations
phases.focus: Plain Language Principles, Diátaxis Framework, Markdown & Static Site Generators

phases.title: Core Technical Documentation
phases.focus: Information Architecture, OpenAPI Specs, Code Samples, Quickstarts & Style Guides

phases.title: Advanced Automation & Formats
phases.focus: Automated Linting, Diagrams, Release Notes, Analytics & Docstring Synchronization

phases.title: Content Strategy & Portfolio
phases.focus: Doc Strategy, Team Leadership, Support Deflection ROI, and Portfolio Defense

nodes.title: Technical Writing Principles & Plain Language
nodes.subtitle: Clarity, brevity, active voice, audience analysis, eliminating jargon, readability scores
learning_objectives: Rewrite complex, convoluted technical paragraphs into clear, active-voice instructions
Calculate Flesch-Kincaid readability scores to ensure appropriate audience comprehension
feynman_prompts: Why is active voice ('Run the command') clearer in documentation than passive voice ('The command should be run')?
key_misconceptions: Assuming that using dense, academic jargon makes technical documentation appear more authoritative

nodes.title: The Diátaxis Framework for Documentation
nodes.subtitle: Tutorials (learning), How-To Guides (problem-solving), Reference (information), Explanation (understanding)
learning_objectives: Classify technical content into the 4 distinct Diátaxis quadrants
Structure tutorials strictly for learning without confusing them with comprehensive reference specs
feynman_prompts: Explain why mixing theoretical explanation into a step-by-step how-to guide frustrates users.
key_misconceptions: Writing an all-in-one document that tries to teach, explain architecture, and list API specs all at once

nodes.title: Docs-as-Code: Markdown, Git & Version Control
nodes.subtitle: Markdown syntax, Git branching, pull request reviews, docs-as-code philosophy
learning_objectives: Manage documentation in GitHub repositories alongside source code
Review technical documentation pull requests with inline suggestions and formatting checks
feynman_prompts: What are the key benefits of treating documentation with the same version control as code?
key_misconceptions: Keeping documentation in isolated Google Docs or wikis disconnected from engineering release cycles

nodes.title: Static Site Generators & Documentation Platforms
nodes.subtitle: Docusaurus, VitePress, MkDocs, Mintlify, configuration, themes, search indexing (Algolia)
learning_objectives: Deploy a responsive documentation portal using Docusaurus or MkDocs
Integrate Algolia DocSearch to enable fast, full-text documentation search
feynman_prompts: How do modern static site generators optimize documentation performance and SEO?
key_misconceptions: Relying on unsearchable, non-responsive PDF manuals for developer documentation

nodes.title: Documentation Information Architecture & Navigation
nodes.subtitle: Navigation hierarchies, sidebars, breadcrumbs, search discoverability, landing pages
learning_objectives: Design multi-level documentation navigation that surfaces answers in under 3 clicks
Craft documentation landing pages that guide users by intent and skill level
feynman_prompts: Why is deep nesting (more than 3 levels) an anti-pattern in documentation sidebars?
key_misconceptions: Organizing documentation chapters around internal company engineering modules rather than user tasks

nodes.title: REST API Documentation & OpenAPI/Swagger
nodes.subtitle: OpenAPI 3.1 specifications, endpoint documentation, request/response schemas, error codes
learning_objectives: Write comprehensive OpenAPI 3.1 YAML specifications for REST endpoints
Document request parameters, JSON body schemas, and explicit HTTP error response codes
feynman_prompts: Why must API documentation provide realistic error response payloads alongside 200 OK examples?
key_misconceptions: Documenting only the 200 OK happy path while leaving authentication and validation errors undocumented

nodes.title: Code Samples, SDK Guides & Multi-Language Snippets
nodes.subtitle: Multi-language code tabs, runnable snippets, verifying code accuracy, sandbox embeds
learning_objectives: Write idiomatic code samples across Python, JavaScript, and cURL
Integrate interactive code sandboxes (StackBlitz, CodeSandbox) into documentation guides
feynman_prompts: Why must code samples in documentation use idiomatic patterns for each specific target language?
key_misconceptions: Using placeholder pseudo-code that fails to run when copied into a developer's terminal

nodes.title: Quickstart Guides & Hands-on Tutorials
nodes.subtitle: Time-to-hello-world, prerequisites, progressive disclosure, post-completion next steps
learning_objectives: Author a 5-minute quickstart guide taking a user from zero to working deployment
Clearly define hardware/software prerequisites before the first instructional step
feynman_prompts: What makes a quickstart guide successful compared to an in-depth reference manual?
key_misconceptions: Assuming the reader already has dependencies installed without explicitly stating requirements

nodes.title: Style Guides & Documentation Standards
nodes.subtitle: Google Developer Documentation Style Guide, Microsoft Manual of Style, terminology glossaries
learning_objectives: Apply the Google Developer Documentation Style Guide to enforce grammatical consistency
Create and maintain a project-wide terminology glossary to eliminate conflicting terms
feynman_prompts: Why is consistent capitalization and terminology essential across a multi-author documentation suite?
key_misconceptions: Using multiple synonymous terms (e.g. 'delete', 'remove', 'purge') interchangeably for the same action

nodes.title: Documentation Testing & Automation (CI/CD)
nodes.subtitle: Vale prose linter, markdownlint, broken link checkers, automated code sample testing
learning_objectives: Configure Vale prose linter rules in GitHub Actions to catch style and voice violations
Automate broken link validation and code sample execution during PR builds
feynman_prompts: How does automated prose linting protect editorial quality across distributed open-source teams?
key_misconceptions: Treating documentation review purely as a manual proofreading chore

nodes.title: Technical Diagramming & Visual Explanations
nodes.subtitle: Mermaid.js, PlantUML, architectural diagrams, sequence diagrams, annotated screenshots
learning_objectives: Render dynamic sequence diagrams and architecture maps using text-based Mermaid.js
Annotate UI screenshots with callout numbers that correspond to step-by-step instructions
feynman_prompts: Why are text-based diagrams (like Mermaid) superior to static PNG exports in docs-as-code repos?
key_misconceptions: Embedding uncompressed, full-screen raw screenshots that quickly become outdated after minor UI changes

nodes.title: Release Notes, Changelogs & Deprecation Notices
nodes.subtitle: Keep a Changelog standard, SemVer communication, breaking change migration guides
learning_objectives: Curate user-centric release notes following the Keep a Changelog specification
Write clear deprecation notices with explicit migration steps and deprecation timelines
feynman_prompts: How do user-facing release notes differ from raw git commit logs?
key_misconceptions: Copying raw Git commit hashes and commit messages directly into customer release notes

nodes.title: Documentation Analytics & Continuous Improvement
nodes.subtitle: Was this page helpful? widgets, search analytics, drop-off analysis, docs user testing
learning_objectives: Analyze search query logs to identify documentation gaps and missing content
Gather actionable user sentiment through page-level feedback widgets and support ticket trends
feynman_prompts: What does a high volume of searches yielding zero results tell a technical writer?
key_misconceptions: Publishing documentation and never reviewing whether users actually find it helpful

nodes.title: Automated Reference Generation (TypeDoc, Sphinx, godoc)
nodes.subtitle: Extracting code comments to docs, docstrings (JSDoc, PEP 257), automated synchronization
learning_objectives: Generate comprehensive API reference documentation directly from typed source code docstrings
Set up automated pipelines that synchronize reference docs on every version release tag
feynman_prompts: Why is code-level docstring generation ideal for reference docs but terrible for conceptual guides?
key_misconceptions: Relying exclusively on auto-generated reference docs and ignoring conceptual tutorials

nodes.title: Localization (l10n) & Writing for Global Readers
nodes.subtitle: Translating technical content, Crowdin/Transifex integration, avoiding idioms, cultural neutrality
learning_objectives: Write culturally neutral English that machine translation engines can accurately parse
Manage continuous localization pipelines with translation management systems
feynman_prompts: Why do colloquial idioms and slang create catastrophic errors during technical translation?
key_misconceptions: Assuming literal word-for-word translation works without contextual localization

nodes.title: Enterprise Security & Compliance Documentation
nodes.subtitle: SOC 2 documentation, audit readiness, disaster recovery runbooks, SLA documentation
learning_objectives: Draft enterprise security whitepapers and compliance architecture specifications
Create disaster recovery and operational runbooks for enterprise IT administrators
feynman_prompts: What makes runbook documentation different from general consumer documentation?
key_misconceptions: Writing ambiguous runbook steps that leave engineers guessing during a midnight production outage

nodes.title: Documentation Strategy, KPIs & Team Leadership
nodes.subtitle: Content audits, calculating doc ROI, reducing support ticket deflection, staffing writers
learning_objectives: Perform holistic documentation inventory audits identifying redundant and outdated pages
Correlate documentation improvements with reductions in customer support ticket volume
feynman_prompts: How do you demonstrate the monetary return on investment of hiring full-time technical writers?
key_misconceptions: Viewing documentation as a low-priority final task to squeeze in right before shipping code

nodes.title: Technical Writing Portfolio & Editorial Review
nodes.subtitle: Sample selection, showing editing before-and-afters, complex topic breakdowns
learning_objectives: Assemble a diverse technical writing portfolio showcasing tutorials, API specs, and architectures
Demonstrate editorial before-and-after improvements and content strategy outcomes
feynman_prompts: Why is explaining your audience analysis and editorial decisions critical in a writing portfolio?
key_misconceptions: Submitting confidential proprietary documentation samples without redaction or permission
